column3: “Nine the hands” is rendered “nine-tenths”; NASB supplies “remained” and “other.”
“Leaders of the province” is rendered “heads of the provinces.” “Israel” is rendered “the Israelites.”
“Brothers” is rendered “kinsmen,” and “the house” as “the temple.”
“Brothers” is rendered “kinsmen,” and “leaders of fathers” as “heads of fathers' households.”
“Mighty men of strength” is rendered “valiant warriors.” NASB keeps “Haggedolim” as a name; it may mean “the great ones.”
“The external work” is rendered “the outside work.”
The Hebrew phrase about leading the thanksgiving is difficult; NASB renders it “the leader in beginning the thanksgiving at prayer,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“The city of holiness” is rendered “the holy city.”
“To before the work” is rendered “for the service.”
“The singers” is rendered “the song leaders,” and “the matter of a day in its day” as “day by day.”
“To the side of the king” is rendered “the king's representative.”
